insights.body: App Total New User · All App: GB +23.8% vs all-country +1.0% (Δ +22.9pp; ≈5% of revenue).

insights.body: New Subs is converting in line with Install across every app (within ±5pp).

insights.title: Forecast → — App Total Revenue likely steady next period — App Total New Subs in line with upstream.
insights.body: App Total New Subs -0.1% moves with its upstream (App Total Install +1.6%); no outsized App Total Revenue swing expected from the trial cohort next period.

insights.title: Broad-based — App Total Revenue down across every app — broad-based, look for a platform-wide cause.
insights.body: App Total Revenue is down across every app (All App -3.2%, YMK -3.3%, YCP -3.7%, YCV -0.6%) — a broad move, so look for a platform-wide cause, not an app-specific one.
